# free-for.dev

## Design and UI

  * [FreeDesign](https://freedesign.example/) - Free online design tool for visual content.
  * [TrialDesign](https://trialdesign.example/) - Free trial only, no continuing plan.
  * [PaidDesign](https://paiddesign.example/) - Subscription required, no free plan.
  * [BrandIcons](https://brandicons.example/) - Free tier includes 500,000 image icon requests per month.

## Generative AI

  * [FreeImageAI](https://freeimageai.example/) - Free image generation API with no signup.
  * [MysteryAI](https://mysteryai.example/) - A tool for things.

## Unselected Section

  * [IgnoreMeToo](https://ignoretoo.example/) - Free service that should not be parsed.
